{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794689792392,"sessionID":"ses_e2427c7a4ffeXsM7nEPBGpA3Tj","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"f9YK0FL5y8te5zuN","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"import math\n\ndef analyze():\n    print(\"=== Month 0 Analysis ===\")\n    # Inference demand projections\n    for g in [0.04, 0.08]:\n        tot_0_7 = sum(6.0 * ((1+g)**m) for m in range(0, 8))\n        tot_8_15 = sum(6.0 * ((1+g)**m) for m in range(8, 16))\n        tot_16_23 = sum(6.0 * ((1+g)**m) for m in range(16, 24))\n        print(f\"Growth {g*100:.0f}%/mo:\")\n        print(f\"  m0..7  inf={tot_0_7:.1f}, train=60, total={tot_0_7+60:.1f} (avg {(tot_0_7+60)/8:.2f}/mo)\")\n        print(f\"  m8..15 inf={tot_8_15:.1f}, train=140, total={tot_8_15+140:.1f} (avg {(tot_8_15+140)/8:.2f}/mo)\")\n        print(f\"  m16..23 inf={tot_16_23:.1f}, train=320, total={tot_16_23+320:.1f} (avg {(tot_16_23+320)/8:.2f}/mo)\")\n        print(f\"  m0 inf by site: us={3.0:.2f}, eu={1.8:.2f}, ap={1.2:.2f}\")\n        print(f\"  m7 inf={6*(1+g)**7:.2f} (us={3*(1+g)**7:.2f}, eu={1.8*(1+g)**7:.2f}, ap={1.2*(1+g)**7:.2f})\")\n        print(f\"  m15 inf={6*(1+g)**15:.2f} (us={3*(1+g)**15:.2f}, eu={1.8*(1+g)**15:.2f}, ap={1.2*(1+g)**15:.2f})\")\n        print(f\"  m23 inf={6*(1+g)**23:.2f} (us={3*(1+g)**23:.2f}, eu={1.8*(1+g)**23:.2f}, ap={1.2*(1+g)**23:.2f})\")\n\n    # Compare buying gen H at month 0 (usable m3..23 = 21 mos, assuming delivery at m3)\n    # Wait: vendor allocation is ~6k/mo loose, ~2k/mo tight.\n    # Already in queue: 4k H to us (placed month -2 -> eligible month 1!).\n    # If we order 4k H at month 0, it joins queue AFTER the 4k already there.\n    # If loose (6k/mo), existing 4k ships in m1 (or m0? wait: let's check queue rules),\n    # and new order becomes eligible in m3, ships in m3.\n    resale_H_m24 = 0.75 * 25.0 * (0.96**24) * 0.5\n    print(f\"\\nGen H resale value at m24 (after N launch): ${resale_H_m24:.2f}M per 1k\")\n    for site, pw_price in [('us', 0.15), ('eu', 0.20), ('ap', 0.12)]:\n        # Assume power contracted at m0, energized at m4, runs m4..27 (24 mos)\n        # Or if using spare power, just marginal power cost for 21 mos\n        pw_24 = 24 * 1.4 * pw_price\n        net_capex = 25.0 - resale_H_m24\n        # Time value of $25M over 21 mos at 0.75%/mo ~ 25*(1.0075^21 - 1) = 4.25\n        # Minus resale TVM? At settlement, cash earns 0.75%/mo if positive.\n        # Better: NPV or total cost including 0.75%/mo opportunity cost on cash spent early\n        opp_cost = 25.0 * ((1.0075**24) - 1) - resale_H_m24 * 0 # resale happens at m24\n        # Wait: if we spend $25M at m0 instead of keeping it earning 0.75%/mo until m24:\n        # At m24, $25M cash would have grown to 25 * 1.0075^24 = $29.91M.\n        # Spending it gives resale $3.52M at m24, so net cash difference at m24 = 29.91 - 3.52 = $26.39M!\n        # Plus power: 1.4*pw_price per month for 24 months (say m4..27, compounded/discounted to m24).\n        cost_21mo = (25.0 * (1.0075**24) - resale_H_m24 + pw_24) / 21.0\n        cost_no_tvm = (net_capex + pw_24) / 21.0\n        print(f\"Gen H vendor ({site}) m3..23 (21 mos): no-TVM=${cost_no_tvm:.3f}M/kH-mo, w/0.75%-TVM=${cost_21mo:.3f}M/kH-mo\")\n\n    # Broker A (1.10x = $27.5M, 90% reliable -> 10% cancel w/ 80% refund = loses 20% of 27.5 = $5.5M; or 35% reliable -> 65% cancel!)\n    # Expected capex for reliable broker A per delivered 1k:\n    # Each order costs 27.5. With p=0.9 delivers (value 27.5), with p=0.1 refunds 22 (loses 5.5).\n    # Expected cost per delivered 1k = 27.5 + (0.1/0.9)*5.5 = $28.11M (usable m2..23 = 22 mos)\n    # If unreliable (p=0.35): 27.5 + (0.65/0.35)*5.5 = $37.71M!\n    print(f\"Broker A reliable expected capex/1k: ${27.5 + (0.1/0.9)*5.5:.2f}M; unreliable: ${27.5 + (0.65/0.35)*5.5:.2f}M\")\n    print(f\"Broker B reliable expected capex/1k: ${31.25 + (0.1/0.9)*6.25:.2f}M; unreliable: ${31.25 + (0.65/0.35)*6.25:.2f}M\")\n\n    # Gen N bought at launch (say m12 -> usable m15..23 = 9 mos; or m10 -> usable m13..23 = 11 mos; or m15 -> usable m18..23 = 6 mos)\n    print(\"\\nGen N ($40M for 2 kH = $20M/kH, 0.8 MW/kH):\")\n    for L in [9, 12, 15]:\n        usable = 24 - (L + 3)\n        resale_N = 0.75 * 40.0 * (0.96**(24 - L))\n        # Power: 1.6 MW for 24 mos (obligations past m23 charged) at US $0.15 -> 24 * 1.6 * 0.15 = $5.76M (for 2 kH)\n        pw_N = 24 * 1.6 * 0.15\n        tvm = 40.0 * ((1.0075**(24-L)) - 1)\n        tot_per_kH_mo = (40.0 + tvm - resale_N + pw_N) / (2 * usable)\n        print(f\"  Launch m{L} ({usable} usable mos): resale=${resale_N:.2f}M, cost=${tot_per_kH_mo:.3f}M/kH-mo\")\n\nanalyze()\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/analyze.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/analyze.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/analyze.py","time":{"start":1794689792039,"end":1794689792244}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dbd8f7ee001vYN6F8SguMhMfR","sessionID":"ses_e2427c7a4ffeXsM7nEPBGpA3Tj","messageID":"msg_1dbd8a42f0012HXD4Q9T0KWykb"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794689819160,"sessionID":"ses_e2427c7a4ffeXsM7nEPBGpA3Tj","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"oyba6pnIgNNHWns2","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"def project():\n    # Current owned: us 6k H (10MW), eu 4k H (6MW), ap 0 (0MW)\n    # Vendor queue: 4k H to us (placed m-2 -> eligible m1)\n    # Reserved: us 2k until m4 (let's check if inclusive of m4 -> probably active in m0..4, i.e. 5 months, or ends m4)\n    \n    # Suppose we want to hit 60 training in m0..7, 140 in m8..15, 320 in m16..23\n    # Let's see how much capacity we have in m0..7 with NO new GPU orders, just existing + reservations:\n    # Existing GPUs: 10k H + 4k H arriving ~m1-m2 (if powered!) = 14k H.\n    # Power currently: 16 MW = 11.4k H max powered!\n    # So we MUST add power quickly (us and/or ap)!\n    \n    # Let's check m0..7 capacity if we power all 14k H by m3-4:\n    # m0: 6+2(us) + 4(eu) + spot_ap(~1.3) = 13.3 kH. Inf ~6.0 -> train ~7.3\n    # m1: 7.14(us) + 2(us res) + 4(eu) + res_ap + spot = ~15-16 kH\n    # Notice: even with all 14k H powered, if inf is 8%/mo (avg 8.0 kH/mo in m0..7):\n    # 14k H gives 14 - 8 = 6 kH/mo training, times 8 = 48 kH-mos + ~10 from m0..4 us res = 58 kH-mos!\n    # That's TIGHT for 60 kH-mos if 8% growth or if power takes 5-6 months to energise!\n    # Plus in m8..15 we need 140 training (17.5/mo) + ~10-15 inf = 27.5 to 32.5 kH/mo!!\n    # With only 14k H, we'd be SHORT by 13.5 to 18.5 kH/mo in m8..15!\n    # Wait: Gen N launches in m9..15, and takes 3 months to arrive -> Gen N CANNOT help much until m12..18!\n    # Specifically, if Gen N launches in m13..15, Gen N arrives in m16..18 (AFTER m8..15 ends!!).\n    \n    print(\"CRITICAL INSIGHT:\")\n    print(\"In months 8..15 we need 140 kH-mos training + 76..118 kH-mos inference = 216..258 kH-mos (27..32 kH/mo)!\")\n    print(\"Gen N launches m9..15 (avg m12) and takes 3+ months to arrive -> m12..18!\")\n    print(\"So for m8..15, we CANNOT rely on Gen N! We need ~28-32 kH/mo from:\")\n    print(\"  1) Existing 14k H\")\n    print(\"  2) More Gen H bought early (m0..5)?\")\n    print(\"  3) Cloud reservations (6m / 12m / 24m) & Options & Spot!\")\n    \n    # Let's compare Gen H bought at m0 vs 12m/24m reservations vs Options!\n    # Wait: If we buy Gen H at m0:\n    #   Cost $25M, usable m3..23 (21 mos).\n    #   Net cost ~ $1.45-1.50M / kH-month (incl power & TVM & resale).\n    #   Wait: What if we buy Gen H at m0..m2 vs 24m cloud reservation?\n    #   24m cloud reservation at m0: index $1.60M * 0.90 = $1.44M/kH-mo (us), $1.368M/kH-mo (ap)!\n    #   Wait: 24m reservation starts m1, ends m24 -> 24 months paid for 23 months used (m1..23):\n    #     ap: $1.368 * 24 / 23 = $1.427M / kH-month! (NO capex cash outlay! NO power lag! NO power overhang! Starts m1!)\n    #     us: $1.440 * 24 / 23 = $1.503M / kH-month!\n    #   Wait: what if cloud index DROPS 25% when Gen N launches (m9..15)?\n    #   If we take a 12m reservation in ap at m0:\n    #     $1.60 * 0.95 * 1.00 = $1.52M / kH-month for m1..12!\n    #     Then at m12, Gen N has likely launched (or is about to), so index drops 25% to ~$1.20M (if loose, even lower: ~0.975^12 * 0.75 * 1.60 = $0.89M!!)!\n    #     Let's check that! If supply is loose, index drifts -2.5%/mo:\n    #       1.60 * 0.975^12 * 0.75 = $0.885M! (clamped to $0.8M!)\n    #       Then a 12m reservation at m12 in ap would cost $0.885 * 0.95 = $0.84M/kH-month!!\n    #     Whereas if supply is TIGHT, index drifts +4%/mo:\n    #       1.60 * 1.04^12 * 0.75 = $1.92M! (Or without launch by m12, $2.56M!)\n    #       AND if tight, reservation caps drop to 1 kH/mo per site!\n    \n    for regime, drift in [(\"loose (-2.5%/mo)\", -0.025), (\"tight (+4%/mo)\", 0.04)]:\n        idx_12 = max(0.8, min(4.0, 1.6 * ((1+drift)**12)))\n        idx_12_postN = max(0.8, min(4.0, idx_12 * 0.75))\n        print(f\"If {regime} for 12 mos: idx_12=${idx_12:.2f}M, post-N=${idx_12_postN:.2f}M\")\n\nproject()\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/plan.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/plan.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/plan.py","time":{"start":1794689819118,"end":1794689819148}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dbd961d2001E4wHJ7jw23qrAB","sessionID":"ses_e2427c7a4ffeXsM7nEPBGpA3Tj","messageID":"msg_1dbd91a34001Ft5NVZu5IaKMzJ"}}

+$40M/month!\n# Spending $150M leaves $250M cash (still earning 0.75%/mo = $1.88M/mo!).\n# Whereas in m9..15 when Gen N launches, we might want to buy 15k-20k Gen N ($600M-$800M!!)!\n# Credit line goes down to -$500M (at 2%/mo interest!!).\n# Wait: $400M + 12 * $40M = $880M total cash inflows by month 12 (minus power/cloud/spot)!\n# If we spend $150M on Gen H at m0, that's $150M less cash when Gen N launches (or we go into -$500M debt at 2%/mo)!\n\n# Let's compute the FULL 24-month cash & capacity model for:\n# Strategy X: Buy some Gen H at m0 (say 4k or 6k) + cloud reservations\n# Strategy Y: Rely mainly on existing 14k H + cloud reservations for m0..12, then buy heavy Gen N at launch!\n\nfor extra_H in [0, 4, 8]:\n    # Suppose extra_H bought at m0 ($25M * extra_H), arrives m3 (usable m3..23 = 21 mos)\n    # Needs extra_H * 1.4 MW power (24 mos at $0.135/MW avg -> $4.54M per 1k H)\n    # Resale at m24: $3.52M per 1k H\n    # Net cash spent on extra_H (incl power, excl interest): (25 + 4.54 - 3.52) = $26.02M per 1k H for 21 kH-mos = $1.239M/kH-mo!\n    # Plus 0.75%/mo TVM for ~21 mos: ~$25M * 0.17 = $4.25M -> $30.27M / 21 = $1.44M/kH-mo!\n    # Wait: if we go into debt at 2%/mo in m12..18 because we spent $25M at m0:\n    # Each $25M spent at m0 costs 0.75%/mo in m0..12 (~$2.3M) + 2%/mo in m12..18 (~$3.2M) -> ~$5.5M TVM -> $1.50M/kH-mo!\n    print(f\"Extra H={extra_H}k: net cost ~$1.45-$1.50M/kH-mo (for 21 mos, m3..23)\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/compare.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/compare.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/compare.py","time":{"start":1794689843676,"end":1794689843730}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dbd9c194001d2mdnb854XAesg","sessionID":"ses_e2427c7a4ffeXsM7nEPBGpA3Tj","messageID":"msg_1dbd96c70001LJ98OVnKGK4PKJ"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794689871601,"sessionID":"ses_e2427c7a4ffeXsM7nEPBGpA3Tj","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"QCItZz4499QGHZQH","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"# Quick check of m0..7 training kH-months with:\n# - buy 4 H vendor ap (arrives m3 if loose, m4-5 if tight; powered m5!)\n# - reserve 3 12 ap (3 if loose, 1 if tight; m1..12)\n# - reserve R_us 12 us (R_us in [0, 2, 3, 4])\n\nfor scenario, g, loose, us_res_m4_excl in [\n    (\"Loose, 8% growth\", 0.08, True, True),\n    (\"Tight, 8% growth\", 0.08, False, True),\n    (\"Loose, 4% growth\", 0.04, True, True),\n]:\n    print(f\"\\n=== {scenario} ===\")\n    for R_us in [0, 2, 4]:\n        tot_train = 0\n        for m in range(8):\n            inf = 6.0 * ((1+g)**m)\n            # us owned powered: m0..3 -> 7.14 (except m0 is 6.0), m4..7 -> 10.0\n            us_own = 6.0 if m == 0 else (7.14 if m < 4 else 10.0)\n            us_old_res = 2.0 if m <= 4 else 0.0\n            us_new_res = (min(R_us, 4) if loose else min(R_us, 1)) if m >= 1 else 0.0\n            \n            eu_own = 4.0\n            \n            ap_own = 4.0 if m >= 5 else 0.0\n            ap_res = (3.0 if loose else 1.0) if m >= 1 else 0.0\n            ap_spot = 1.5 if m == 0 and loose else (0.5 if m == 0 else 0.0)\n            # If tight in m1..7 and ap_res=1, ap inf grows from 1.29 to 2.06 -> need spot in ap (0.5)\n            ap_inf = 0.2 * inf\n            if m >= 1 and (ap_own + ap_res) < ap_inf:\n                ap_spot = min(0.5 if not loose else 3.0, max(0, ap_inf - (ap_own + ap_res)))\n            \n            cap = us_own + us_old_res + us_new_res + eu_own + ap_own + ap_res + ap_spot\n            train = cap - inf\n            tot_train += train\n        print(f\"  R_us={R_us}: total training m0..7 = {tot_train:.1f} / 60\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/check_m0_7.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/check_m0_7.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/check_m0_7.py","time":{"start":1794689871562,"end":1794689871584}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dbda2ea00015pcuuge3XLqR5F","sessionID":"ses_e2427c7a4ffeXsM7nEPBGpA3Tj","messageID":"msg_1dbda0f09001gmFI1N5BFo744a"}}

{"type":"reasoning","timestamp":1794689890632,"sessionID":"ses_e2427c7a4ffeXsM7nEPBGpA3Tj","part":{"id":"prt_1dbda4cbd001ZPsq3sZNEvb1g5","messageID":"msg_1dbda381f001ZNQY9bJvJleKZx","sessionID":"ses_e2427c7a4ffeXsM7nEPBGpA3Tj","type":"reasoning","text":"**Analyzing Month 0**\n\nI've been intensely scrutinizing `check_m0_7.py`, especially the scenario where `R_us` is zero in Month 0, and we only reserve in `ap` and buy GPUs. Also, `us` doesn't seem to need Month 0 reservations, with plenty of inference capacity.\n\n\n**Refining Resource Allocation**\n\nI'm now zeroing in on resource allocation, specifically in `ap` given its power activation at Month 5. I realize I need to front-load a `reserve 3 12 ap` from Month 1, and also start a `set_spot 1.5 ap` in Month 0. I'm exploring the nuances: What if that reservation only gives 1kH due to tight supply? This leads me to adjust my strategy - in Months 1-4, it can cover the inference gap with spot and then reserve later. If the supply is instead loose, I should delay further reservations, since index drifts down, and no need to spend above capacity. I am also considering `buy_gpus 4 H vendor ap`.\n\n\n**Evaluating GPU Acquisition Timing**\n\nI'm now heavily focused on the optimal timing for GPU acquisition, particularly for `ap`. Delaying the `buy_gpus` order until Month 1 saves on TVM costs and allows us to assess Month 0's market tightness before spending $100M. The only potential downside I see is if Month 0 is tight, potentially resulting in delays for shipments. However, the benefits of waiting, and the fact that `ap` power is already secured, seem to outweigh that risk.\n\n\n**Prioritizing Early Resource Buys**\n\nI've been reevaluating the benefits of early resource purchases. The incremental cost for `4 H vendor ap`, given our existing power contract, is only $1.389M/kH-month. This early investment in Month 0 is both inexpensive and a critical safeguard against potential supply constraints or export controls. Reserving and setting spot covers, and I'll confirm that the early GPU buy ensures capacity.\n\n\n**Optimizing Resource Reservation**\n\nI'm now determining the optimal reservation strategy. I see that reserving two units in `ap` from Month 1 covers inference and allows substantial training, saving $1.52M per month. I'm carefully weighing this against the future need for the third kH, as Month 8 onward requires more training, and I'm calculating the costs associated with potentially reserving it later. My current thinking is that if supply in Month 7 is tight, I will have lost time. (+2 res ap) = 21.0\n#   m6..7: same = 21.0\n# Wait: check m3..7 training at 8% growth!\ndone = 22.88\nfor m in range(3, 8):\n    inf = 6.0 * (1.08**m)\n    cap = {3: 15.14, 4: 19.0, 5: 21.0, 6: 21.0, 7: 21.0}[m]\n    done += (cap - inf)\n    print(f\"m{m}: cap={cap:.2f}, inf~{inf:.2f}, train~{cap-inf:.2f}, cum_train={done:.2f}\")\n\n# Now check m8..15!\n# Training needed in m8..15: 140 kH-months!\n# Inference in m8..15 at 8% growth:\ninf_8_15 = sum(6.0 * (1.08**m) for m in range(8, 16))\nprint(f\"\\nm8..15 inference (8%): {inf_8_15:.1f} kH-mos! Total needed = {inf_8_15 + 140:.1f} kH-mos ({(inf_8_15+140)/8:.2f} kH/mo avg!)\")\n# Wait: what capacity do we ALREADY have in m8..15?\n# Owned H: us=11, eu=4, ap=4 -> 19 kH/mo * 8 = 152 kH-mos!\n# Reserved ap: 1k (m8..12 = 5), 1k (m8..13 = 6) -> 11 kH-mos!\n# Total ALREADY = 163 kH-mos!\n# SHORTFALL in m8..15 = (inf_8_15 + 140) - 163!\nshortfall_8_15 = (inf_8_15 + 140) - 163\nprint(f\"m8..15 SHORTFALL (before new H, N, options, reservations): {shortfall_8_15:.1f} kH-mos ({shortfall_8_15/8:.2f} kH/mo)!!\")\n\n# WAIT A SECOND! {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794689977189,"sessionID":"ses_e2427c7a4ffeXsM7nEPBGpA3Tj","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"cMESyvf4iW8QzYxY","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/m3_longterm.py","content":"# Model m8..23 (140 train in m8..15, 320 train in m16..23) at 8% inf growth!\n# Suppose launch L in {9, 11, 13}, and tight continues (worst case for supply)!\n# Note: in tight supply:\n#   - vendor N allocation = 1.5k/mo (= 3 kH/mo)\n#   - broker A (if reliable!) = up to 4k/mo N (= 8 kH/mo!), arrives in 2 mos!\n#   - reservation cap = 1 kH/mo per site (= 3 kH/mo total)\n#   - options: max 20 bought/mo, UNLIMITED exercise, 6 mos each @ $1.60/kH-mo!\n#   - existing owned H: 19k H (us=11, eu=4, ap=4)\n\nfor L in [9, 11, 13]:\n    print(f\"\\n=== Launch L={L} (tight supply, 8% inf growth) ===\")\n    # Suppose we buy N via vendor (1.5k/mo = 3 kH/mo arriving L+3..23) AND Broker A (4k/mo = 8 kH/mo arriving L+2..23)?\n    # Wait: how much cash does 4k/mo N cost? $160M/mo!!\n    # Let's check total cash available:\n    # Start m3 cash = $372.4M + 20*$40M = $1172.4M + $500M credit line = $1672M!\n    # Suppose we buy:\n    #   From mL..m19: 1.5k/mo vendor N (= 15k N = 30 kH N -> $600M) + say 2k/mo Broker A N for 5 mos (= 10k N = 20 kH N -> $440M)\n    #   Wait: 19k H + 30kH N + 20kH N = 69 kH owned by m22!\n    # Wait: how much power do we need for 19k H + 50kH N?\n    #   19k H = 26.6 MW\n    #   50kH N (25k GPUs) = 40 MW\n    #   Total = 66.6 MW!\n    #   Right now we have: us 10MW (expires m19) + 6MW (expires m27), eu 6MW (expires m19), ap 6MW (expires m28)\n    #   So in m16..19 we have 28 MW; in m20..23 we ONLY have 12 MW unless we sign new power by m11..15!!\n    \n    # Let's compute m8..15 capacity if we use 12 options (exercised m7 for m8..13) + Gen N arriving m(L+2)/m(L+3) + spot/res:\n    inf_8_15 = sum(6.0*(1.08**m) for m in range(8, 16))\n    need_8_15 = inf_8_15 + 140\n    # Base capacity in m8..15: 19*8 + 11(ap res) = 163\n    # Suppose 12 options exercised m7 -> +12*6 = +72 kH-mos (m8..13) -> total 235 kH-mos!\n    # Plus Gen N arriving at L+2 (Broker A 3k N/mo = 6 kH/mo) + L+3 (Vendor 1.5k N/mo = 3 kH/mo):\n    n_8_15 = 0\n    for m in range(8, 16):\n        if m >= L + 2:\n            n_8_15 += 6 * (m - (L+1)) # rough ramp\n    print(f\"  m8..15 needed={need_8_15:.1f}, base+12opt={235:.1f}, gap={need_8_15-235:.1f} (covered by N/res/spot)\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/m3_longterm.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/m3_longterm.py","time":{"start":1794689977158,"end":1794689977177}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dbdbcb31001TdlZNfRNqoLxJj","sessionID":"ses_e2427c7a4ffeXsM7nEPBGpA3Tj","messageID":"msg_1dbdb9e68001Wuy88aNQwASwWn"}}

The index took a significant hit, plummeting by -5.2%. At the same time, there was a news item about cloud providers adjusting reserved GPU capacity pricing. It is a bit sparse. The spot price for this moment is at a pricey $3.262M.\n\n\n**Calculating Bayes Updates**\n\nI've been running Bayes updates, and it's getting interesting. Initially, the loose prior was about 31%. The index drop shifted things, making it 68% loose. Then, the spot ratio data brought it to *95%* tight! Hold on, though, I'm second-guessing. A 2.94 sigma event is rare in a normal distribution, but is it possible with a 10% switch? The index has dropped for three months in a row.\n\n\n**Re-evaluating Spot Noise**\n\nI am now looking at the index's trajectory over the last three months, specifically the consecutive drops totaling -9.1%. This raises questions about the spot ratio's behavior during this downturn.  I'm now reconsidering whether \"tight\" spot noise is solely responsible or if \"loose\" spot noise is at play. I'm running some calculations to assess probabilities under the various scenarios.  I'm going to re-read the rules to confirm the meaning of \"spot noise\".\n\n\n**Investigating Noise Dynamics**\n\nI'm now diving deeper into the index data, specifically the sigma values for each month's drop. Under a \"tight\" spot scenario, the cumulative drop translates to a -2.46 sigma event, which is statistically improbable. However, under a \"loose\" spot scenario, the index drops align more closely with the mean. The fact that news was loose in months 4 and 6 is informative. I'm now also running scenarios to see if spot noise was high.\n\n\n**Comparing Reservation Values**\n\nOkay, I'm now comparing reservation values for months six and seven. I've calculated that the 12-month Asia-Pacific reservation, starting in month seven, is cheaper than the option. Even with a wasted month, the effective cost is still better, and it provides coverage through month 18! Similarly, the 12-month US reservation is also cheaper, though not quite as dramatically. However, the 24-month Asia-Pacific reservation, while initially cheaper, becomes more expensive due to more wasted months, so it is a poor choice.\n\n\n**Assessing Reserve Timing**\n\nI'm now running through potential scenarios for reservation timing. I'm considering a strategy of reserving three Asia-Pacific and four US 12-month contracts in Month 6. I'm also factoring in a potential Gen N launch between Months 9 and 13, which could drastically reduce contract prices. I'm modeling the outcomes of waiting until Month 7 to reserve contracts. If Month 6 is loose, reserving now provides significant immediate capacity, whereas waiting has trade-offs! I am still working on the numbers.\n\n\n**Deciding Reserve Actions**\n\nMy current focus is on deciding between buying options in Month 6 versus Month 7. If Month 6 is loose, those options at $1.767M could be costlier than post-launch cloud costs of $1.18M. However, if supply is tight, options are the only way to secure the needed capacity. I'm considering reserving three 12-month AP contracts in Month 6. This approach provides immediate capacity if Month 6 is loose, while confirming a tight supply situation and allowing me to buy options in Month 7 if it turns out to be tight.\n\n\n**Evaluating Power Timings**\n\nI'm now determining when to contract Asia-Pacific power. Given Gen N's expected arrival, signing a 16 MW contract in Month 6 might result in significant waste due to early energization. Waiting until Month 7 or 8 for a smaller 12 MW contract looks more optimal, aligning with Gen N's arrival and minimizing wasted months.\n\n\n","time":{"start":1794690023736,"end":1794690037013}}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794690138953,"sessionID":"ses_e2427c7a4ffeXsM7nEPBGpA3Tj","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"TIRH5Umpc9vdoeHR","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/m10_check.py","content":"# Month 10 projection for m10..15 and m16..23!\n# Base capacity in m10..15:\n#   Owned H: 19 kH\n#   Existing reservations:\n#     ap: m10..12 = 5, m13 = 4, m14..15 = 3\n#     us: m10..15 = 2\n#     eu: m10..15 = 2\n#   Total existing base in m10..15:\nbase_10_15 = {10: 28, 11: 28, 12: 28, 13: 27, 14: 26, 15: 26}\n#   Vendor queue #5 (5k N to us, eligible m12):\n#     If tight (1.5k/mo): m12=1.5k(3kH), m13=3k(6kH), m14=4.5k(9kH), m15=5k(10kH) -> +28 kH-mos!\n#     If loose (4k/mo): m12=4k(8kH), m13..15=5k(10kH) -> +38 kH-mos!\n#   Broker A #4 (4k N to ap, confirms end m10, arrives m11):\n#     If delivers: m11..15 = +8 kH/mo * 5 = +40 kH-mos!\n#     If cancels: +0 kH-mos (refunds $140.8M!)\n\n# Projected inference m10..15 (assuming 8% from 11.41 at m9, or 6*1.08^m):\ninf_8 = sum(6.0*(1.08**m) for m in range(10, 16)) # m10..15 = 95.1\ninf_4 = sum(11.41*(1.04**(m-9)) for m in range(10, 16)) # ~78.7\nprint(f\"m10..15 inf: 8%={inf_8:.1f}, 4%={inf_4:.1f}\")\nprint(f\"m10..15 total needed (110.75 train + inf): 8%={110.75+inf_8:.1f}, 4%={110.75+inf_4:.1f}\")\n\nbase_sum = sum(base_10_15.values())\nprint(f\"Base capacity m10..15 = {base_sum}\")\nprint(f\"With Vendor #5 (tight +28): {base_sum + 28}\")\nprint(f\"With Broker A #4 (+40): {base_sum + 28 + 40} (vs needed {110.75+inf_8:.1f} -> surplus/deficit = {base_sum+28+40 - (110.75+inf_8):.1f}!)\")\nprint(f\"If Broker A #4 CANCELS: {base_sum + 28} (deficit = {110.75+inf_8 - (base_sum+28):.1f}!)\")\n\n# Look at that!\n# Even if Broker A CANCELS, the deficit in m10..15 is ~15 kH-mos, which is EASILY covered by reserving 1k/mo at ap/us/eu ($1.02-$1.19M/kH-mo!) in m10..12!\n# Let's check reserving 12m in m10 (runs m11..22 -> ALL 12 MONTHS inside m11..22, ZERO wasted past m23!!):\n#   ap 12m: $1.078 * 0.95 = $1.024M/kH-mo (m11..22!)\n#   us 12m: $1.078 * 1.00 = $1.078M/kH-mo (m11..22!)\n#   eu 12m: $1.078 * 1.10 = $1.186M/kH-mo (m11..22!)\n# Compare $1.02-$1.19M/kH-mo (100% utilized m11..22!) vs Vendor Gen N ordered m10 ($1.489M/kH-mo)!!\n# Cloud 12m reservations at $1.02-$1.19M/kH-mo are STILL CHEAPER than Vendor Gen N ($1.489M/kH-mo)!!\n# AND we STILL need ~67 kH/mo in m16..23!!\n# So reserving 3 12 ap, 4 12 us, 3 12 eu in Month 10 (gets 1+1+1 if tight, or 3+4+3 if loose at $1.02-$1.19M!) is an ABSOLUTE NO-BRAINER!\n\n# What about ordering MORE Gen N in Month 10?\n# Wait: right now Vendor queue has #5 (5k N to us, eligible m12).\n# If tight (1.5k/mo), #5 won't even finish until m15! So ordering more vendor N in m10 wouldn't ship until m15-16 anyway!\n# UNLESS supply turns loose (4k/mo) — in which case we'll see at m12 or m11, and if Broker A cancels at end of m10 we get $140.8M back AND know!\n# And our cash right now is $223.6M (+40M/mo -> ~$260M in m11). Don't over-commit vendor queue before seeing Broker A's result at end of m10!\n\n# Check m10 site inference & spot:\n# m10 inf ~ 12.95 (if 8%): us=6.48 (cap=13), eu=3.89 (cap=6), ap=2.59 (cap=9). All sites well covered!\n# Wait: standing spot in ap is currently 1.5 kH! Setting `set_spot 0 ap` saves cash unless we need spot later!\nprint(\"\\nWait: check if we need MORE power for m16..23!\")\n# Remember: us 10MW & eu 6MW expire at m19!\n# Current power in m20..23:\n#   us: 6MW (m4..27) + 10MW (m12..35) = 16 MW (if us keeps 11k H = 15.4 MW, only 0.6 MW spare! Wait: in m12..19 us has 26 MW, so 5k N = 8 MW fits in m12..19, AND at m20 us drops to 16 MW while 11k H + 5k N needs 15.4 + 8 = 23.4 MW!!).\n#   eu: 6MW expires at m19 -> 0 MW at m20..23! {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794690258748,"sessionID":"ses_e2427c7a4ffeXsM7nEPBGpA3Tj","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"tkC0ULVlzDRSRbGL","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/m15_exact.py","content":"# Exact Month 15 -> m16..23 calculator!\n# Let's check inference trajectory from m14=19.11 (say trend ~18.5 at m14, or 6.15*1.08^m):\n# Note: in m15, growth could STILL switch to 4% in m15 (1/8 chance if not yet switched)!\n# Safe plan: size capacity for 8% growth (using 6.15*1.08^m, ~18.1 at m14, ~19.5 at m15):\ninf = {m: 6.15 * (1.08**m) for m in range(15, 24)}\nprint(\"Projected 8% inference (6.15 * 1.08^m):\")\nfor m in range(15, 24):\n    print(f\"  m{m}: tot={inf[m]:5.2f} (us={0.5*inf[m]:5.2f}, eu={0.3*inf[m]:5.2f}, ap={0.2*inf[m]:5.2f})\")\nprint(f\"Sum inf m16..23 = {sum(inf[m] for m in range(16, 24)):.1f} kH-mos\")\nprint(f\"Total needed m16..23 (320 + inf) = {320 + sum(inf[m] for m in range(16, 24)):.1f} kH-mos\")\n\n# Base capacity in m16..23 (with #6 finishing in m16..17 -> ap gets +4.14 kH):\n# Wait: #6 has 2.07k left! At 1.5k/mo tight, #6 ships ~1.5k in m15 (+3 kH by m16) and ~0.57k in m16 (+1.14 kH by m17)!\n# So by m16: ap has 4 H + 6.43 N = 16.86 kH; by m17: ap has 4 H + 7 N = 18 kH!\n# us has 11 H + 5 N = 21 kH (all powered! 26MW m16, 34MW m17..19, 24MW m20..23 >= 23.4MW needed!)\n# eu has 4 H = 4 kH (6MW expires m19, new 6MW energises m19 -> powered m16..23!)\n# Existing reservations in m16..23:\nres_us = {16:3, 17:3, 18:3, 19:3, 20:3, 21:3, 22:2, 23:1}\nres_eu = {16:3, 17:3, 18:3, 19:3, 20:2, 21:2, 22:1, 23:0}\nres_ap = {16:4, 17:4, 18:4, 19:3, 20:3, 21:3, 22:2, 23:1}\n\nbase_tot = 0\nprint(\"\\nBase capacity by site in m16..23 (BEFORE m15-17 6m res & options):\")\nfor m in range(16, 24):\n    us_c = 21 + res_us[m]\n    eu_c = 4 + res_eu[m]\n    ap_c = (16.86 if m == 16 else 18.0) + res_ap[m]\n    tot = us_c + eu_c + ap_c\n    base_tot += tot\n    print(f\"  m{m}: us={us_c:5.2f} (inf={0.5*inf[m]:5.2f}), eu={eu_c:5.2f} (inf={0.3*inf[m]:5.2f}), ap={ap_c:5.2f} (inf={0.2*inf[m]:5.2f}) | tot={tot:5.2f}\")\n\nshortfall = (320 + sum(inf[m] for m in range(16, 24))) - base_tot\nprint(f\"\\nBase sum m16..23 = {base_tot:.1f} -> SHORTFALL = {shortfall:.1f} kH-mos!\")\n\n# Look at eu deficit specifically!\n# In m18: eu base=7.0 vs inf~7.4 (slightly tight!)\n# In m19: eu base=7.0 vs inf~8.0 (short 1.0!)\n# In m20: eu base=6.0 vs inf~8.6 (short 2.6!)\n# In m21: eu base=6.0 vs inf~9.3 (short 3.3!)\n# In m22: eu base=5.0 vs inf~10.0 (short 5.0!)\n# In m23: eu base=4.0 vs inf~10.8 (short 6.8!)\n#\n# Look how CLEANLY 6m reservations + Options solve BOTH eu inference AND the 320 training shortfall:\n#   - In m15 (starts m16..21): reserve 3 6 ap, reserve 3 6 us, reserve 2 6 eu (if tight: 1+1+1=3 kH -> +18 kH-mos)\n#     + exercise Options in eu (say 4 options in m15 for m16..21 -> eu gets +5 total in m16..21 -> eu=12 in m16..19, 11 in m20..21!)\n#   - In m16 (starts m17..22): reserve 6m ap/us (2 kH) + exercise Options in eu (say 3 options -> eu gets +3 in m17..22 -> eu=15 in m17..19, 14 in m20..21, 13 in m22!)\n#   - In m17 (starts m18..23): reserve 6m ap/us (2 kH) + exercise Options in eu (say 6 options -> eu gets +6 in m18..23 -> eu=16 in m22, 10 in m23? Wait: check!)\n#     Wait: if we exercise 4 options in m15 (m16..21), 3 in m16 (m17..22), and 7 in m17 (m18..23):\n#       eu gets: m16(+5), m17(+8), m18(+14), m19(+14), m20(+14), m21(+14), m22(+10), m23(+7)!!\n#       Let's check eu cap in m23: 4 (owned) + 0 (old res) + 7 (m17 options) = 11 kH >= 10.8 kH inf!! (Safe!)\n#       Or even better: 8 options in m17 (for m18..23) -> m23 eu = 12 kH (super safe even with +5% noise on 10.8 = 11.34!!)!\n#     Wait: let's check total kH-mos added by:\n#       - m15..17 6m reservations (if tight: 3 in m15 + 2 in m16 + 2 in m17 = 7 * 6 = 42 kH-mos)\n#       - 15 Options (4 in m15 + 3 in m16 + 8 in m17 = 15 * 6 = 90 kH-mos)\n#       Total added = 42 + 90 = 132 kH-mos (vs shortfall 132-135!)\n#       Wait: what if in m18..23, index drops or we can also use spot if needed, OR buy 16-17 Options?\n#       Remember: buying Options costs ONLY $1.0M/kH upfront, and we DON'T have to exercise them until m16/m17 (after seeing m15 and m16 inference and whether tight/loose)!\n#       Wait: if we buy **18 Options** right now in m15 ($18M, cash is $191.3M -> leaves $173.3M!):\n#         - Exercise **4** in m15 (in `eu`, for `m16..21`)!\n#         - Reserve `2 6 ap`, `2 6 us`, `1 6 eu` in m15 (for `m16..21`)!\n#         - Then in m16 and m17, we STILL have **14 Options** held, and can check exact inference/prices/regime before deciding how many of the 14 to exercise in m16 (for `m17..22`) and m17 (for `m18..23`), plus m16-17 `6m` reservations!\n\n# Let's simulate m16..23 with this exact plan!\nopt_tot = {16: 4, 17: 7, 18: 15, 19: 15, 20: 15, 21: 15, 22: 11, 23: 8} # 4 at m15, 3 at m16, 8 at m17\nres_new_tot = {16: 3, 17: 5, 18: 7, 19: 7, 20: 7, 21: 7, 22: 4, 23: 2} # 3 at m15, 2 at m16, 2 at m17 (tight!)\nres_new_eu = {16: 1, 17: 1, 18: 1, 19: 1, 20: 1, 21: 1, 22: 0, 23: 0}\ntot_cap_sum = 0\ntot_inf_sum = 0\nprint(\"\\nSimulation of m16..23 with 6m res (3+2+2) + 15 Options (4+3+8 in eu):\")\nfor m in range(16, 24):\n    us_c = 21 + res_us[m] + (res_new_tot[m]-res_new_eu[m])//2\n    eu_c = 4 + res_eu[m] + res_new_eu[m] + opt_tot[m]\n    ap_c = (16.86 if m==16 else 18.0) + res_ap[m] + (res_new_tot[m]-res_new_eu[m]+1)//2\n    tot = us_c + eu_c + ap_c\n    tot_cap_sum += tot\n    tot_inf_sum += inf[m]\n    print(f\"  m{m}: tot={tot:5.2f}, inf={inf[m]:5.2f}, train={tot-inf[m]:5.2f} | eu={eu_c:2d} (inf={0.3*inf[m]:5.2f})\")\nprint(f\"Total m16..23 training = {tot_cap_sum - tot_inf_sum:.1f} / 320 !!\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/m15_exact.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/m15_exact.py","time":{"start":1794690258671,"end":1794690258733}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dbe016d0001BC5jNeZPXmLHoG","sessionID":"ses_e2427c7a4ffeXsM7nEPBGpA3Tj","messageID":"msg_1dbdfdf5b001o3psNAvRg8KpgN"}}
